title: task.list — Response
description: Returns a deterministic, cursor-paginated queue page. Claimable tasks appear first, sorted by created_at ascending then id ascending. Leased tasks follow, sorted by claim_expires_at ascending, then created_at ascending, then id ascending. Cursors are opaque and preserve that ordering.

tasks.description: Tasks returned by the queue scan in deterministic order.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the result set is exhausted.
